During the trial, the pickup window is Tuesday from 2 to 5 p.m. Residents report a missed library delivery by leaving a message on the trial voicemail line. Staff review messages the following morning. The office keeps a separate log for day-to-day questions. Each entry contains the date received and a brief description, followed by the initials of the person who filed it." , "status": "supported"}}
